findings.summary: PR #68 Security CI (gitleaks generic-api-key) flagged the localStorage key constant in varavu_selavu_ui/src/analytics/diagnostics/consent.ts:13 as a false-positive secret (entropy 3.54). Fixed by renaming the constant to DIAGNOSTICS_STORAGE_NAME.

varavu_selavu_app/varavu_selavu_service/api/telemetry.py used deprecated HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE and an unpruned in-memory _rate_buckets dict. Fixed: switched to HTTP_413_CONTENT_TOO_LARGE and added stale-key pruning when >2,000 principals are tracked.

Web/mobile diagnostics clients and independent consent UIs are built and tested, and ErrorBoundary wires render errors, but App.tsx/AuthContext lifecycle wiring (setServerEnabled/setSignedIn/setSessionToken/startWebVitalsDiagnostics) is not yet hooked up. Safe while CLIENT_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED=false; must be wired before enabling diagnostics in staging.

[ux] AnalyticsPreferences.tsx Turn off / Allow performance diagnostics buttons both use outlined variant (matching the existing Analytics buttons above them; state is announced via role='status'). Optional visual polish.
